description: The Commission concluded that mistreatment of Palestinian detainees resulted from an intentional policy of using sexual, reproductive and other forms of gender-based violence to humiliate and degrade Palestinians in detention, and that such practices increased significantly in severity and frequency after 7 October 2023.
energy_note: Not excesses. A policy, per the Commission.

aspect: What it found was standard procedure
description: Forced public stripping and nudity, sexual harassment including threats of rape, and sexual assault were found to de facto form part of standard operating procedures - and sexualised torture to have been committed with either explicit orders or implicit encouragement from top civilian and military leadership.
energy_note: Stripping, as a procedure rather than an incident.

aspect: The October 2024 report, on the legal characterisation
description: The Commission found thousands of child and adult detainees, many arbitrarily detained, subjected to widespread and systematic abuse amounting to the war crime and crime against humanity of torture, and the war crime of rape and other forms of sexual violence. It found both Israel and Palestinian armed groups responsible for torture and sexual and gender-based violence.
energy_note: Named as crimes against humanity, and not only on one side.

aspect: Impunity was treated as part of the finding
description: All documented incidents were met with impunity, which the Commission held makes civilian and military leaders as responsible as the direct perpetrators.

The 2026 Secretary-General's report on conflict-related sexual violence stated that patterns of sexual violence against Palestinians in detention continued during 2025, and that verified cases should be understood as indicative of a broader pattern rather than an exhaustive list - particularly as Israel continues to deny UN investigators access.

Israel rejected the Commission's conclusions; the Prime Minister called the report biased and Israel's UN mission said IDF policies prohibit such misconduct. The dataset records the finding and the denial together.
energy_note: Findings, and the rejection of them, both on the record.

aspect: Disclosure afterwards carries its own cost for a woman
description: Where the community response to sexual violence is silence or blame, the released detainee has a second decision to make about whether to say what happened - and rational non-disclosure means the true prevalence is unknown and understated in every source including this one.
energy_note: A number nobody has, for reasons that are themselves the harm.
